english: Tap the camera to scan your first document.
target: Ketik kamera untuk mengimbas dokumen pertama anda.
backtrans: Tap the camera to scan your first document.

target: Satu imej setiap halaman, tanpa kehilangan kualiti
backtrans: One image per page, without loss of quality
H&P [??: abbreviation of Hitam & Putih (Black & White), unclear/unusual]

english: Documents inside will not be deleted.
target: Dokumen di dalamnya tidak akan dipadam.
backtrans: The documents inside will not be deleted.

english: No documents in this folder yet.
target: Belum ada dokumen dalam folder ini.
backtrans: There are no documents in this folder yet.

english: This folder is no longer available.
backtrans: This folder is no longer available.

english: This isn't automatic sync. Export creates a single encrypted backup file you move to your new device yourself, then import there.
target: Ini bukan penyegerakan automatik. Eksport mencipta satu fail sandaran tersulit yang anda pindahkan sendiri ke peranti baharu anda, kemudian import di sana.
backtrans: This is not automatic synchronisation. Export creates one encrypted backup file that you move yourself to your new device, then import there.

english: Could not import this backup. Check the password and try again.
target: Tidak dapat mengimport sandaran ini. Semak kata laluan dan cuba lagi.
backtrans: Could not import this backup. Check the password and try again.

english: {count, plural, =1{1 document imported} other{{count} documents imported}}
target: {count, plural, =1{1 dokumen diimport} other{{count} dokumen diimport}}
backtrans: {count, plural, =1{1 document imported} other{{count} documents imported}}

english: Pricing is still loading — try again in a moment.
target: Harga masih dimuatkan — cuba lagi sebentar.
backtrans: Prices are still loading — try again in a moment.

english: This scan is no longer available.
backtrans: This scan is no longer available.

english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
backtrans: A problem occurred. Please try again.

english: This will undo all filters, rotations, crops, resizes, and eraser strokes on this page.
target: Ini akan membatalkan semua penapis, putaran, pemotongan, perubahan saiz, dan sapuan pemadam pada halaman ini.
backtrans: This will undo all filters, rotations, cropping, resizing, and eraser strokes on this page.

english: Front side captured. Now capture the back side.
target: Bahagian depan telah diimbas. Sekarang imbas bahagian belakang.
backtrans: The front side has been scanned. Now scan the back side.

english: Use your saved signature or draw a new one?
target: Gunakan tandatangan tersimpan atau lukis yang baharu?
backtrans: Use the saved signature or draw a new one?

english: No documents to batch export. Scan some first.
target: Tiada dokumen untuk eksport kelompok. Imbas beberapa dahulu.
backtrans: No documents for batch export. Scan some first.

english: No folders yet. Create one from the home screen.
target: Belum ada folder. Cipta satu dari skrin utama.
backtrans: No folders yet. Create one from the main screen.

english: Copy text to clipboard after scan
target: Salin teks ke papan klip selepas imbasan
backtrans: Copy text to the clipboard after a scan
Play a sound when the scan is complete

target: Maklum balas haptik apabila imbasan selesai
backtrans: Haptic feedback when the scan is complete
Debug Logs [??: 'Nyahpepijat' is the standard Malay term, fine]

english: DOCX sources render poorly as pages — save inside the app is limited to JPG/PNG from image, PDF, TXT or CSV sources. Use Export & Share for this file.
target: Sumber DOCX dipaparkan dengan teruk sebagai halaman — simpan dalam aplikasi terhad kepada JPG/PNG dari imej, PDF, TXT atau sumber CSV. Guna Eksport & Kongsi untuk fail ini.
backtrans: DOCX sources are rendered badly as pages — saving inside the app is limited to JPG/PNG from images, PDF, TXT or CSV sources. Use Export & Share for this file.

english: To save inside the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other targets are exported as files.
target: Untuk menyimpan dalam aplikasi, pilih JPG atau PNG. Sasaran lain dieksport sebagai fail.
backtrans: To save inside the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other targets are exported as files.
Encoding page {current} from {total}... [??: 'dari' (from) instead of 'daripada'/'of'; slightly unnatural]

english: Tap a spot to sample its color
target: Ketik satu tempat untuk mengambil sampel warna
backtrans: Tap a spot to sample the color

target: OCR tidak tersedia pada peranti ini.
backtrans: OCR is not available on this device.

english: Your device doesn't support the advanced document scanner. Take a photo with your Camera app, then tap Import below to crop and save it.
target: Peranti anda tidak menyokong pengimbas dokumen lanjutan. Ambil foto dengan aplikasi Kamera, kemudian ketik Import di bawah untuk memotong dan menyimpannya.
backtrans: Your device does not support the advanced document scanner. Take a photo with the Camera application, then tap Import below to crop and save it.

target: Pengebilan tidak tersedia — cuba lagi kemudian.
backtrans: Billing is not available — try again later.

english: No internet. Connect once to download the language pack.
target: Tiada internet. Sambung sekali untuk memuat turun pek bahasa.
backtrans: No internet. Connect once to download the language pack.

english: Language pack downloading or not ready. Try again shortly.
target: Pek bahasa sedang dimuat turun atau belum sedia. Cuba lagi sebentar.
backtrans: The language pack is being downloaded or is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.

english: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
target: DOKUMEN ANDA KEKAL PADA PERANTI ANDA
backtrans: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
TAP-TAP FILLING [??: 'ketik-ketik' reads as repeated tapping; unclear vs 'tap to type']

english: Your entire document office — scan, edit, sign, and export — in one private app.
target: Seluruh pejabat dokumen anda — imbas, edit, tandatangan, dan eksport — dalam satu aplikasi peribadi.
backtrans: Your whole document office — scan, edit, sign, and export — in one private app.

english: Annotate, sign, watermark, fill forms, seal, and more — every tool free and unlimited.
target: Anotasi, tandatangan, tera air, isi borang, mohor, dan banyak lagi — setiap alat percuma dan tanpa had.
backtrans: Annotate, sign, water mark, fill forms, seals, and much more — every tool free and unlimited.

english: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing ever leaves your device.
target: Gunakan KatharScan dalam {count} bahasa. OCR berjalan pada telefon anda — tiada apa meninggalkan peranti.
backtrans: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing leaves the device. [??: 'Gunakan KatharScan dalam {count} bahasa' says use the app in N languages, not that OCR supports N languages]

english: E-sign contracts, type-to-fill forms, and stamp enterprise seals in seconds.
target: E-tandatangan kontrak, isi borang, dan cop mohor korporat dalam beberapa saat.
backtrans: E-sign contracts, fill forms, and stamp corporate seals in a few seconds.

english: Every edit stays reversible — undo, redo, and revert to original anytime.
target: Setiap editan kekal boleh diterbalikkan — buat asal, buat semula, dan kembalikan ke asal bila-bila masa.
backtrans: Every edit stays reversible — undo, redo, and return to original at any time.

english: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Your documents never leave your device.
target: Tiada akaun, tiada storan awan, tiada tera air. Dokumen anda tidak pernah meninggalkan peranti anda.
backtrans: No account, no cloud storage, no water marks. Your documents never leave your device.

english: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.
target: Sokong KatharScan dengan pembelian sekali sahaja. Semua ciri kekal percuma.
backtrans: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase only. All features stay free.

english: This is a non-consumable purchase. Restore it anytime on any device with the same store account.
target: Ini adalah pembelian sekali bayar yang tidak luak. Pulihkannya bila-bila masa pada mana-mana peranti dengan akaun kedai yang sama.
backtrans: This is a one-time payment, non-consumable purchase. Restore it at any time on any device with the same store account. [??: 'tidak luak' literally 'non-perishable/non-expiring'; fine for non-consumable]

english: KatharScan ran into a problem displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — they're stored on this device and this doesn't affect them.
target: KatharScan menghadapi masalah memaparkan skrin ini. Imbasan anda selamat — ia disimpan pada peranti ini dan ini tidak menjejaskannya.
backtrans: KatharScan has trouble displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — they are stored on this device and this does not affect them.

target: Tiada imbasan sepadan dengan carian anda.

english: No folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.
target: Belum ada folder. Ketik ikon folder untuk mencipta satu.
backtrans: No folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.

english: No favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.
target: Belum ada kegemaran. Ketik ikon bintang pada dokumen untuk menambahnya.
backtrans: No favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.
Saturated [??: 'Tepu' means saturated; label for saturation, abbreviated oddly]

english: Share it with friends who need a powerful document scanner.
target: Kongsinya dengan rakan yang memerlukan pengimbas dokumen berkuasa.
backtrans: Share it with friends who need a powerful document scanner.

english: Your feedback helps us grow and keeps the app free.
target: Maklum balas anda membantu kami berkembang dan memastikan aplikasi percuma.
backtrans: Your feedback helps us grow and keep the application free.

target: Imbasan ID dua sisi: Depan + Belakang

english: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public release featuring unlimited scanning, 29 languages, and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG, and CSV.
target: Selamat datang ke KatharScan! Ini ialah keluaran awam pertama dengan imbasan tanpa had, 29 bahasa dan eksport ke PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG dan CSV.
backtrans: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public release with unlimited scans, 29 languages and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG and CSV.

english: Allow background reminders for unexported documents
target: Benarkan peringatan latar belakang untuk dokumen yang belum dieksport
backtrans: Allow background reminders for documents not yet exported

english: Allow the app to occasionally ask for a rating
backtrans: Allow the application to occasionally ask for a rating

english: Allow the app to occasionally suggest sharing
backtrans: Allow the application to occasionally suggest sharing

english: The pages could not be attached to the email. Use Share to send the pages.
target: Halaman tidak dapat dilampirkan pada e-mel. Gunakan Kongsi untuk menghantar halaman.
backtrans: Pages could not be attached to the e-mail. Use Share to send the pages.

english: This document has no text yet. Run OCR on it first.
target: Dokumen ini belum mempunyai teks. Jalankan OCR dahulu.
backtrans: This document does not have text yet. Run OCR first.

english: Your latest changes could not be saved.
target: Perubahan terkini anda tidak dapat disimpan.
backtrans: Your latest changes could not be saved.

english: Tap the page where you want to type
target: Ketik halaman di tempat anda mahu menaip
backtrans: Tap the page where you want to type

english: This PDF has {count} pages. Pages that are pictures are read with OCR (about 10 seconds each); pages with real text are instant.
target: PDF ini mempunyai {count} halaman. Halaman gambar dibaca dengan OCR (kira-kira 10 saat setiap satu); halaman teks sebenar segera.
backtrans: This PDF has {count} pages. Picture pages are read with OCR (about 10 seconds each); real text pages are instant.
Page {page} out of {total} · about {minutes} min more
Faded stamp look [??: 'cop' = stamp, 'lusuh' = shabby/faded; ink look vs stamp look]
Make white translucent [??: 'lutsinar' = translucent/transparent; unclear if fully transparent]

english: Draw or type a new one
backtrans: Draw or type a new one

english: Check the pages (the document has {count} pages)
Couldn't find the page edges. Drag the corners.
target: Tepi halaman tidak ditemui. Seret bucu.
backtrans: Page edges not found. Drag the corners.

english: Enlarging doesn't add detail — the page may look soft.
target: Pembesaran tidak menambah butiran — halaman mungkin kelihatan kabur.
backtrans: Enlargement does not add detail — the page may look blurry.

english: Delete {count} pages? They are removed when you save.
target: Padam {count} halaman? Ia dibuang apabila anda simpan.
backtrans: Delete {count} pages? They are removed when you save.

english: Could not get under {mb} MB; sent the smallest version.
target: Tidak dapat kurang daripada {mb} MB; versi terkecil dihantar.
backtrans: Could not get below {mb} MB; the smallest version was sent.
